name: io.github.textbee/mcp
title: textbee SMS
description: Send and read SMS through your own Android phone via textbee.dev, the open-source SMS gateway.

environmentVariables.name: TEXTBEE_API_KEY
environmentVariables.description: API key from the textbee dashboard (app.textbee.dev/dashboard).

environmentVariables.name: TEXTBEE_BASE_URL
environmentVariables.description: Self-hosted instance URL. Defaults to https://api.textbee.dev; the /api/v1 suffix is added automatically.
